corrections.why: The list gives gfc-318 as a number from an older Georgia Forestry Commission list, not a lookout register entry. Please check before applying.

notes_for_editor: Thin: the tnlandforms row gives coordinates, county and the gfc number; the Wikipedia citation only places the name in Terrell County. The name 'dawson' may echo the town; nothing found ties the tower to the town itself. Not in the NHLR Georgia list (cached) or the Eastern US Lookouts index (no Terrell entry). A Georgia Historic Newspapers search for 'fire tower' Dawson Terrell returned one 2019 Sylvester paper hit whose OCR page had no tower passage; not used. No status, history or access source found; the story says so.
